description: This Dart source file defines the `NotesRepository` class, which manages notes data, performs CRUD operations, and maintains state for a Flutter app utilizing a SQLite database backend. It provides methods for searching, adding, updating, and deleting notes, and notifies listeners of state changes.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: A class serving as a state manager and interface for note data, backed by SQLite, providing CRUD operations and search filtering, designed for integration with Flutter's widget tree via ChangeNotifier.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the repository by loading the current notes list from the database.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reloads the notes list from the database based on the current search query and updates the loading state.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets a search query string and refreshes the notes list accordingly.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with specified title and content, inserts it into the database, and refreshes the list.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing note and refreshes the data.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes the note with the specified id from the database and updates the state.

methods.name: byId
methods.description: Retrieves a note by id from the current cached list, returns null if not present or id is null.
